thesis: The Q3 beat (revenue 207.6M, net income 37.8M vs 17.4M) and healthcare sector leadership support the uptrend, but the 31.00 post-earnings high was rejected with a long upper wick and price 28.60 already sits above the 24.5 mean analyst target. Reward/risk from the 28.25 mid entry to the 31.00 target over a 26.30 stop is only 1.41, below the 1.5 Buy threshold, and the technical card calls the setup mediocre. Thin liquidity (about 12.6M average daily dollar volume) and 21.7% short interest add volatility without improving the edge, so no new position.
invalidation: A daily close below 26.45 breaks the setup; a close above 31.0 on volume would turn it into a breakout worth re-rating.
key_risks: 31.00 rejection candle and only 1.41R to target
Price above analyst mean target 24.5 (downgrade/target-lag risk)
Gross margin slipping to ~48% on IMS remediation costs and pricing pressure
Short interest ~21.7% of float makes moves violent
Neutral regime with QQQ near the -8% risk-off line and ^TNX at 5.048
